summary: Cold visual review of the three Claude 1962 Twenty-first Sunday after Pentecost PDFs. Every page was opened at full size: 1700x2200 rasters from build-artifacts-2, whose review-run.json records the sealed hashes; concise page 2 was also re-rendered at 200 dpi and matched that raster pixel for pixel (AE 0). Contact sheets were opened first. Artifacts: expansive study 61-twenty-first-after-pentecost.pdf, sha256 b29d4ebd2c792148b552fdc4ef812f209fcd3fc215a7a45362105b29ccc223ca, pages 1-37 of 37; concise study 61-twenty-first-after-pentecost-synthesis.pdf, sha256 963401884390649cde76c9dd2346bdb0c32af3597ba71cc3c364c13717717deb, pages 1-12 of 12; homily 61-twenty-first-after-pentecost-homily.pdf, sha256 2137ef1d58e1a99bcaf2e9d562067416dda2e95fade04541d3fe36b38fec6b16, pages 1-3 of 3. Also checked: both sealed aux hashes and all 27 render-input hashes against the working tree. Since the last visual review only generation-metadata.tex, sections/concise/03-date-location.tex and synthesis.tex changed, so the study and homily differ only in the revision timestamp. The logs have no overfull or underfull boxes, undefined references or rerun requests. Every font is embedded Latin Modern Type 1, on letter paper, 11pt article, 0.75in margins. There are no raster images, and colour saturation is zero on all 52 pages. The concise zref markers match the pages: inventory and the four sense rows on page 1, chronology on page 2, themes on pages 3-4, commentary from page 5. Page counts 37 and 12 sit within 20-50 and 10-12. The lane headings and fourSenses blocks are consistent across all three readings (study pp. 16-30), and the comparison table on p. 30 is intact. The homily has a full-width title, a two-column speech on pp. 1-2 with no inline apparatus, and a full-width Note on Sources and Delivery with References on p. 3. Each final page carries the timestamp and the compact rights colophon. Prior blocking VIS-001 is resolved: every orientation row on concise page 2 now has white space below it, and the chronology still stands alone on that page. Lookup at ordinary size on concise page 2: the Communion, Ps 118:81, 84, 86, appears in three psalm rows. They are 'Historical setting', occasion date unresolved; 'Composition: Psalms', before c. 165 B.C.; and 'Traditional attribution: David's reign', disputed B.C. 1055-1015. Each passage label now pairs with its date at a glance, as the Offertory's Job row (seventh to fifth centuries B.C.) already did. Prior advisory VIS-004 is resolved: the descriptive line under the concise title now starts with a capital. Three standing advisories remain unchanged in files this round did not touch (VIS-002, VIS-003, VIS-005). The rubrical occurrence note between the page-1 map and the four sense rows was judged part of the map's account of the day, not displaced apparatus. Limits: the review used rasters, text layers and logs; nothing was printed on paper. Verdict PASS.
